name: api_key_rotation_guard
description:
Guard for LLM-proposed API key lifecycle actions as a single triage node. The
model proposes one typed action (request_id, key_id, action
rotate/revoke/extend, age_days, new_key_length, extend_days, reason); this
workflow owns the key_id format, the age hard limit, the new-key length, the
early-rotation rule and the extension bound. Port of
code/qwen_vm/app_scenarios/api_key_rotation_guard.
Folding boundaries (documented, not computed in the DSL):
- JSON parsing details (dangerous tokens, JSON object, required fields,
action enum) fold into the `proposal` choice.
- The policy table (max_age_days / recommended_age_days /
force_early_rotation) is a fixed fixture; each check folds into one verdict
choice. The Python engine accumulates every error; the port expresses
«first failing check» in the Python source order (key_id, age, rotate
length, early rotation, extension), documented here. revoke carries no
extra check and therefore approves whenever the schema is valid.
Emitted labels: reject_proposal, reject_key_id, reject_age,
reject_new_key_length, reject_early_rotation, reject_extension, approve.

proposal.instructions: Does the model response parse as exactly one {request_id, key_id, action, reason} object (no dangerous tokens, all required fields present, action in rotate/revoke/extend)?

criteria.malformed: dangerous token, bad JSON, missing field or bad action

key_id.instructions: Does key_id match the key-[A-Za-z0-9]{8,64} format?

age.instructions: Is the key age within the policy hard limit (age_days <= max_age_days)?

new_key.instructions: For a rotate action, is the new key length at least 32 characters? (not_rotate when the action is not rotate)

criteria.ok: new key length meets the minimum
criteria.too_short: new key length is below minimum

early.instructions: For a rotate action, is the rotation allowed (key age >= recommended, or force_early_rotation set)? (not_rotate when the action is not rotate)

extension.instructions: For an extend action, does extend_days stay within the remaining hard limit (extend_days <= max_age_days - age_days)? (not_extend when the action is not extend)

criteria.ok: extension stays within the hard limit
criteria.too_long: extension would exceed the hard limit
